subject: Updated MAP after budget shift — draft and responsibilities
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Sandeep Rao <sandeep@valence.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-15T16:20:00-08:00
Subject: Post-demo recap + MAP draft attached

Hi Sandeep — great session today, thanks for the thorough walkthrough of Valence's inference requirements. Per our discussion, I attached a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) to this thread and captured the high-level milestones we discussed. Key points: 

- Target initial pilot: 30 GPU-hours/month for 3 months
- Objectives: reduce per-inference latency to <60ms p50 and prove cost parity vs current infra
- Dependencies from Valence: SOC 2 questionnaire return, network peering window, and procurement approval for Q1 budget
- Redwood responsibilities: scoped pilot config, dedicated test environment, and security appendix provided

Next steps (proposed):
1) You review the MAP draft and indicate any missing milestones/owners by 2026-11-20.
2) If procurement needs more detail, loop in the procurement email and we'll provide a short SOW appendix.
3) We schedule a technical onboarding slot the week of 11/29 (30–45 min).

Attachment: MAP-draft-v1.xlsx (worksheet: milestones & owners).

Thanks — I’ll keep Marissa and Karthik in the loop for provisioning and commercial alignment.

— Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

Attachment stub: MAP-draft-v1.xlsx (xlsx, 28KB)

From: Sandeep Rao <sandeep@valence.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Valence AI Procurement <procurement@valence.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-18T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + MAP draft attached

Thanks Lauren — appreciated the summary and the MAP. Quick update from our side: our execs pushed the budget review window to the first week of January (we were expecting December), so our procurement sign-off will slip. That means we need to re-forecast the pilot start and target close. 

Impact and asks:
- New target close: 2027-01-28 (was 2026-12-15). Please confirm if Redwood can hold the proposed pilot configuration and pricing through the new window.
- Priority shift: procurement wants a shorter pilot with an option to extend if results look good. They asked us to reduce initial committed GPU-hours to 20 GPU-hours/month and front-load the success metrics review at week 3.
- Dependency change: networking peering needs to happen during Valence's maintenance window (1/10–1/12). Can Redwood allocate an engineer for the peering window?

We reviewed the security appendix and will send back three clarifying questions by 11/20. I've CC'd procurement to keep them current.

— Sandeep Rao
Head of ML Platforms | Valence AI
Sandeep@valence.ai | +1 212-555-4444

---
Forwarded attachments referenced: security-appendix.pdf (pdf, 54KB)

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Sandeep Rao <sandeep@valence.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-20T11:04:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + MAP draft attached

Sandeep — thanks for the heads up and the details. Short answers below; I'll update the MAP and share a revised version by end of week.

- Pricing/hold: We can honor the quoted pilot pricing through 2027-02-15 if Valence signs the pilot SOW and returns a purchase order by 2027-01-15. I’ll include this deadline in the MAP to keep expectations aligned.
- Pilot sizing: Happy to revise the commitment to 20 GPU-hours/month with an accelerated success check at week 3. We’ll include explicit success criteria (latency p50, throughput, and cost/req).
- Peering window: Yes — Redwood infra can schedule an engineer for 1/10–1/12. I’ve asked Karthik to flag capacity for the peering task.

Milestone changes I will make in the MAP: 
* Move "Procurement sign-off" to 2027-01-15 (owner: Valence procurement).
* Pilot start: target 2027-01-20 (owner: Redwood provisioning).
* Week-3 success review: 2027-02-10 (owner: joint).
* Final decision / conversion: 2027-02-28 (owner: Valence execs)

I’ll upload MAP-draft-v2 to the shared Drive and add a change log. If any of these new dates are a hard constraint for Valence procurement, let me know and we can consider a short terms addendum.

— Lauren

---
Related link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB-MAP-drafts

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Sandeep Rao <sandeep@valence.ai>, Valence AI Procurement <procurement@valence.ai>
Date: 2026-12-08T09:35:00-08:00
Subject: MAP v2 confirmed (revised milestones & owners)

Looping everyone with the updated MAP summary after internal alignment. I reviewed capacity and security notes and confirmed with engineering the peering slot and provisioning timeline. Below is the consolidated MAP summary (final draft for procurement):

Mutual Action Plan — high level (final draft):
- Document: MAP-draft-v2.xlsx (uploaded to Drive)
- Pilot configuration: 20 GPU-hours/month, 3-week initial evaluation cadence
- Milestone: Procurement PO received — target 2027-01-15 (owner: Valence procurement)
- Milestone: Pilot provisioning & peering — target 2027-01-20, peering execution 2027-01-10 to 2027-01-12 (owner: Redwood infra, contact: Karthik Iyer)
- Milestone: Week-3 success review — target 2027-02-10 (owners: joint leads) — success criteria attached in MAP workbook
- Milestone: Exec decision/convert — target 2027-02-28 (owner: Valence execs)
- Dependencies: SOC 2 clarifications answered by 2026-11-24; procurement budget window shifted to Jan; network maintenance window locked by Valence procurement

Next operational asks for Valence procurement (to finalize before 1/15):
1) Confirm PO amount and send to procurement@redwood.com.
2) Approve the peering maintenance window (1/10–1/12) and assign an on-call network contact.
3) Confirm whether a shortened trial SOW is required — if so we can provide a 1-page addendum for signature within 48 hours.

Attachments: MAP-draft-v2.xlsx, security-appendix.pdf

If there are no further edits, we’ll create a DocuSign package for the pilot SOW and aim to have that in procurement’s inbox by 2026-12-10 to keep the Jan timeline feasible.

— Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineering Lead | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
